constraints.service_description: Half the outlets in the apartment lost power

success_criteria.notes: Success if the assistant schedules an emergency electrical visit at the earliest window available in the tool results and reports the provider, window, and confirmation code.

task.objective: Half my outlets just died, can someone come today

injected_behaviors.instructions: The user is anxious about the outage and repeatedly presses for speed — asking 'how soon can they get here?' and 'is that the fastest option?' after each assistant message. They accept the earliest available slot rather than comparing options, and push back briefly if the assistant suggests a later time.

persona.name: Dr. Rachel Kim
persona.bio: Rachel Kim works for the Maryland Department of Health tracking infectious disease outbreaks and analyzing public health data. She monitors flu trends, investigates foodborne illness clusters, and writes reports for health officials. Her days involve lots of data analysis, stakeholder calls, and the occasional field investigation.
sample_messages: Setting up county health director briefing for next Tuesday 2pm. Need confirmation from all 5 directors + send them the data packet
CDC EIS conference April 12-15. Book flight + hotel, need to arrive evening of the 11th
Grant approved! Ordering 4 laptops for the epi team - specs in the shared doc. Processing timeline?

<action type="say">
Understood—losing half your outlets is something to address quickly.

Before I set up an electrician for today, I need a few details:

1) Location:  
• Full address, or at least city + ZIP?

2) Timing today:  
• What time windows work for you? (e.g., “anytime,” “after 2 pm,” “6–9 pm”)

3) Safety check (answer yes/no if you’re not sure):  
• Do any outlets feel warm, smell burnt, or show visible charring?  
• Do you hear buzzing at the panel, or did any breakers trip and refuse to reset?

4) Preferences (optional):  
• Minimum rating (1–5 stars)?  
• Are you more sensitive to price or to getting the very fastest response?

Once you share that, I’ll look for same-day electricians in your area and walk you through the best options.
</action>
